pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: cross-repository work goes to one workspace thread
experience: Asked for a thread that changes both the API and the web app, an agent must launch one thread on the workspace that holds both repositories, in a worktree (its default), not one thread per repository or a thread in the workspace's empty folder.
rule: t3_project_list: A project with `roots` is a workspace of other projects' repositories. / t3_thread_launch workspaceStrategy: A workspace (project with `roots`) runs only in 'worktree', its default.

setup.context: Repository: /home/user/acme/api (acme/api). This is the local machine.

prompt: Start a new thread in T3 Code that adds a CSV export: the endpoint in the api repo and the button in the web app. Use the workspace I set up for both; that thread does the work.

source.request: Multi-root workspaces (feat/multi-root-workspaces): a workspace thread runs only in a new worktree of every root. Authored Acme scenario; no field transcript.

notes: Launch results come from T3 defaults. Either an omitted workspaceStrategy or 'worktree' passes.

pattern: one-repository thread stays on its project
experience: With a workspace registered, an ordinary thread for one repository must still launch on that project, in its folder, not on the workspace or in a worktree nobody asked for.
rule: t3_thread_launch workspaceStrategy: A workspace (project with `roots`) runs only in 'worktree', its default.
